text: Obstetrics and gynecology consists of obstetrics, gynecology and reproductive medicine. Obstetrics studies the physiological and pathological changes of pregnant and postpartum women, embryos and fetuses during pregnancy, childbirth and the puerperium, as well as the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of pathological changes. Gynecology studies the physiological and pathological changes of the female reproductive system during non-pregnancy periods and conducts corresponding prevention, diagnosis and treatment. Reproductive medicine is a comprehensive medical discipline related to reproduction, focusing on multiple areas of human reproduction as well as biological and medical issues related to conception.
